vintage: INSEE recensement 2023, detailed commune tables for Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Saint-Barthélemy and Saint-Martin, geography 2026-01-01
methodology: Commune-level counts from the 2023 census are distributed over commune polygons and summed within each hex. Values cover only Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Saint-Barthélemy and Saint-Martin; the rest of France is null because these are territory-specific detailed census tables.
